bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: The main overhead was propagating one new operating rule through requirements, specs, memory anchors, prompts, workflows, and history.
improvement_candidates: Create a scaffold helper for new governance agents that generates requirement/spec/history/evaluation shells.
Consider a deterministic checker that verifies new workflow and prompt entries are routed from the prompt router and memory bootstrap.
